<title level="1" right="Focus 1" pfs="Standard">
[Ancestral Memories](/Spells.aspx?ID=493)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Sorcerer" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=148" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 402 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Bloodline**
[Imperial](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=9)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

The memories of long-dead spellcasters grant you knowledge in a specific skill. Choose any non-Lore skill, or a [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill related to the ancient empire from which your bloodline sprang. You temporarily become trained in that skill and might gain other memories associated with an ancestor who was trained in that skill. If you attempt a task or activity that lasts beyond this spell's duration, use the lower proficiency modifier.

---
**Heightened (6th)** You temporarily become an expert in the skill you choose.
name: Ancestral Memories
